title: chat-types gaps: role color forms, Message topic/subject/expiry
description: SpaceRole.color (space.rs:17, Option<String>) and RolePatch.color (space_set.rs:151) accept only strings; Space/get fails on a Design Tokens object or CAM16 array color (spec Color Representation: clients MUST handle all three). Coordinated change with chat-server memory.rs:2664. Message lacks typed topic_id, subject, expires_after_read_seconds (spec L641-660); they only survive in extra.
notes:
Done: SpaceRole.color is now serde_json::Value (Space/get and addRoles accept all three color forms); Message typed topic_id/subject/expires_after_read_seconds. BLOCKED: RolePatch.color (space_set.rs:151) still Clearable<String> so updateRoles rejects object/array colors. Changing it breaks compilation of the existing test space_set.rs role_patch_color_set (asserts Some(Clearable::Set("#ff00ff".to_owned())); Option has no cross-type PartialEq), and the run rules forbid editing existing tests. Needs approval to change that assertion to Clearable::Set(json!("#ff00ff")). Wire test blocked by JMAP-yt1w.13 (addRoles requires id).
Unblocked: RolePatch.color now Option<Clearable<serde_json::Value>>; role_patch_color_set assertion type-changed per approval (iii). Added space_set role_patch_color_accepts_all_three_representations and server tests/role_member_apply.rs update_role_color_preserves_all_three_representations. Wire test still blocked by JMAP-yt1w.13 (client Space/set create carries no roles and addRoles requires id).
fix done in b82ab4f4: tests space_role_color_accepts_all_three_representations, role_patch_color_accepts_all_three_representations, message_topic_subject_expires_after_read_are_typed (chat-types), update_role_color_preserves_all_three_representations (chat-server role_member_apply)
close_reason: Fixed against jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7; test-first, reviewed, gates green (stable/beta/1.88)
